subject: Physics
chapter: Chapter 9: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments
central_question: How do reflection and refraction form images, and how are mirrors, lenses, prisms and optical instruments analysed with rays?
in_scope_units: Ray model and Cartesian sign convention
Thin lenses and lens maker’s formula
banned_topics: Wavefront, interference and diffraction from Chapter 10
Medical physiology beyond the optical model

known_pitfalls.claim: Every image behind a mirror or lens is real.
known_pitfalls.correction: Virtual images arise from apparent, not actual, ray convergence.

known_pitfalls.claim: Total internal reflection occurs from a rarer to a denser medium.
known_pitfalls.correction: It requires denser-to-rarer incidence above the critical angle.

known_pitfalls.claim: Linear magnification and angular magnifying power are identical.
